The Challenge

A Funded Startup with No Inbound Pipeline

In late 2024, Murphy & ReferPro raised $2.7 million in seed funding for their referral automation software aimed at home service contractors. While they had a proven product and offer, they lacked a consistent, scalable system for generating inbound leads. Their target market (contractors) often didn't even know such a solution existed, making traditional search-only strategies ineffective.

The Strategy

The 'Metazation' Surround Sound System

We implemented a surround sound digital strategy designed to educate the market and then capture the resulting interest. Meta Ads introduced the solution to business owners, moving decision-makers from top-of-funnel awareness to bottom-of-funnel intent. Google Ads captured the specific search intent generated by the Meta campaigns.

After three months of initial growth, we leveraged a proprietary 'Metazation' strategy using Performance Max to replicate Meta's audience demand generation directly inside Google. This created a self-reinforcing cycle where awareness generated intent, and intent was captured across both platforms.

Metazation Performance Max Meta Awareness Google Intent Capture B2B SaaS Growth
The Results

Repeatable B2B Growth

Between February and July 2025, ReferPro achieved a complete transformation of its inbound pipeline.

464%

Year-over-Year Growth

By synchronizing social awareness with search intent, we created a repeatable growth engine that transformed ReferPro from a newly funded startup into a market-scaling leader, achieving 464% YoY growth and earning recognition as a '2025 Startup to Watch.' The efficiency of the initial 3-month run allowed ReferPro to double their monthly ad spend while maintaining high performance. Referral leads convert 3x more than standard leads, and our campaigns fed that engine at scale.
